property_summary: After any call to addToBalance, the balance of any account returned by getBalance must be at least what it was before the call (monotonic non-decrease), but the buggy empty body leaves the balance unchanged while msg.value is lost forever, so the invariant balance_after >= balance_before + msg.value (for the caller) fails.
change_summary: Delete the entire function body of addToBalance, making it a no-op that never updates userBalance.
